title: DATA_TAMPER / integrity: repeated cancel calls may append duplicate 'order_canceled' ledger entries to order history
unsupported_reason: The hypothesis is that order.history should contain exactly one 'order_canceled' entry regardless of how many times cancel is called (an array-length/uniqueness check on the event ledger), not a numeric sum comparison. sum_lte only expresses 'sum of numeric fields <= a numeric limit' and cannot count array entries or check for duplicate event types. This requires a count/uniqueness predicate not currently supported by the plan schema.
